messages:
maya: LobsterFin CS pinged about intermittent 503s from their dedicated pool in us-west-2. SLA p99 slipping. Can someone own triage & provide ETA? (They reported it started ~10:15am PST)
ashwin: I'm on it. Seeing increased OOM kills on pool nodes, likely qemu process memory spike after the new model quant change. Digging into logs now.
jordan: If it's OOMs, quick workaround is to reduce max_inflight for that pool and reroute heavy customers to shared hosts temporarily. I can apply routing change.
emily_oncall: +1 to Jordan. We should also open a rollout ticket and make sure we can rollback canary. Post the exact command you run so SRE can follow.
kai: opened a hotfix PR reducing max_inflight default to 50 and adding a guard for KV cache size: github.com/redwood/serving/pull/842 :rocket: 
ashwin: Thanks Kai. CI passed for unit tests, but need one approval from eng-sre. @jordan can you review? I plan to canary deploy to pool-7 at 10:40 and monitor p95/p99 for 15m.
jordan: Reviewing now. Quick note: when you canary, use the `kubectl set env` command to avoid editing the whole configmap: 
```
kubectl set env configmap/serving-config MAX_INFLIGHT=50 -n redwood-serving
```
I'll also push a temporary routing override to send LobsterFin to shared-pool-2 if errors > 10% for 5m.
lena_cs: Heads-up from CS: told LobsterFin we'll have a mitigation in ~30–45m and will follow up after stabilization. They're on a call with their SREs now :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
emily_oncall: Ops-bot has been asked to create incident and attach runbook. ops-bot, can you link the runbook + timeline?
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-49321 created, runbook: https://wiki.redwood/infrastructure/runbooks/dedicated-ooms, paging roster updated. :rotating_light: 
maya: Great. Owners: Ashwin (triage + logs), Kai (fix PR), Jordan (oncall rollout + routing), Emily (postmortem/responsible comms). ETA for mitigation (routing or canary) before 11:00 PST?
ashwin: If PR review goes quick and canary looks stable, ETA ~25–30m. Will post status update here at +10m and +25m. :thumbsup: 
jordan: Rolling canary to pool-7 now, setting alerts for error rate and CPU. Will update once we hit stable window.
kai: PR merged, triggering canary deploy pipeline. cc @eng-sre for fast approval on rollback window.
ashwin: Observability shows error rate down 70% on canary within 5m. Still monitoring kv-cache growth. If it keeps rising, we'll revert and route.
lena_cs: Passing update to customer: mitigation in flight, seeing improvement. Thanks team.
maya: Thanks everyone. If anything hits regress, tag this thread and ping oncall. We'll capture follow-up actions in the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
